meaning: A mandatory request header is missing.
fix: Set serverIp (the X-KM-IP-V4 header) and check any proxy that strips headers.

meaning: Invalid order id: must be 5-20 alphanumeric characters.
fix: Use generateOrderId() or an order id that matches the rule.

meaning: The transaction time is outside the allowed window.
fix: Fix the server clock (NTP). The SDK sends Bangladesh time (UTC+6).
Check any custom clock passed to the client.

meaning: Duplicate order id on the same day.
